user.title: Cats and Dogs Facts
user.description: Configure Cats and Dogs Facts. The integration will fetch cat and dog facts from the given JSON URL and update the sensor on the configured interval.

data_description.json_url: URL to a JSON file containing a list of facts, or an object with a 'facts' key.
data_description.random: Pick a random fact on each update. Disable for sequential order.
data_description.update_interval: How long between each new fact. Examples: 30m, 6h, 1d, 1d12h (max 7d).

error.invalid_interval: Invalid interval. Use formats like 30m, 6h, 1d or 1d12h (max 7d).
